item.title: Needed 1+1, built a functional programming language
item.description:
📝 One way to represent this is to make every operation a different case in our expression type: Expr ::= Add Expr Expr | Sub Expr Expr | Mul Expr Expr | Div Expr Expr | Val But what do these different cases actually represent. And when I looked at the structure: Add: Expr x Expr → Expr Sub: Expr x Expr → Expr Mul: Expr x Expr → Expr Div: Expr x Expr → Expr They all take two expressions and produce one expression. So now we can just represent our expression as: Expr ::= Func Expr Expr | Val The evaluator doesn’t need to know what a function does.
🔗 Read more: https://hereticpleb.vercel.app/blog/needed-one-plus-one/
